'''Power farms''' were large structures used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thule/Legends|Thule]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] destroyed the power farms during the [[Battle of Thule]].
